message_source_quote: This is not a reproduction of Raman et al. (2026): self-written pairs, a different stance verb pair, and the prefix-injection configuration rather than their read-cell/up-to-read injection.
writeup_source_quote: Raman et al. (2026) steered with a think/don't-think stance from WSB's directed_modulation items, injected at every position up to the read cell.

differences.message_quote: Content/task contrasts (concept-completion, function-vector, concept-production) and label-free stances all failed (~0.12), confirming WBS's finding that only the suppression stance transfers.
differences.what: The message adds that other contrast types (content/task contrasts, label-free stances) were tried and failed, explicitly framing this as confirming a prior finding from the source (referred to as WBS) that only the suppression stance transfers; the write-up never mentions this exploration or this prior finding of the source at all.

rationale: Both documents name Raman et al. (2026) and give essentially the same novelty claim relative to it: self-written pairs, a different stance-verb pair, and prefix injection rather than the source's read-cell/up-to-read injection, with prefix injection found to be far more effective. The message additionally claims this result confirms a further, more specific finding attributed to the source (that only the suppression stance transfers, after other contrast types failed), a point the write-up does not mention at all.
